answer: A verdict only settles when 3 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the ridge audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. That is 30 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
